payload.title: Rating agent at propose: suggested stars a person confirms
payload.description:
At `propose` the agent stores its suggestion beside the record as a machine suggestion (never in the rating field) and raises one grouped soft review per day: 'N ratings suggested, M five-star candidates'. A person confirms, changes or ignores; a person's rating always wins and is never overwritten.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Suggestions are visible and separate from ratings.
- One grouped request per day.
- A person's rating is never changed by the agent.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- rating-suggestions.feature: a suggestion appears beside the item; confirming makes it the person's rating; an item a person rated is skipped; candidates are listed, not rated.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** First agent: rating and curation on one site. Slice code L2 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
